data.long_meaning: The name Darcie is derived from the Old English word ‘dære’ meaning ‘dear’ or ‘darling’. It was later popularized in the English-speaking world by the Normans. In the Middle Ages, it was a common name for girls born to noble families. The name Darcie carries the meaning “Darling, Dear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Darcie usually hope their child will grow to embody darling, dear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darcie total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
data.cultural_impact: The name Darcie became popular in the English-speaking world due to its association with nobility and romance. It was a common name for girls in medieval Europe, and it continues to be used as a given name in the Anglophone world. The use of the name Darcie also reflects the influence of the Normans on English culture, as they brought the name to England during their invasion in the 11th century.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Darcie holds a spiritual significance as a reminder of the value and worth of every individual in the eyes of God. The meaning of the name 'dear' or 'darling' suggests that each person is beloved by God and deserving of love and care. Additionally, the name can serve as a reminder of the importance of cultivating deep, meaningful relationships with others, reflecting the Christian values of love, compassion, and community. When we call someone by the name Darcie, we are acknowledging their intrinsic worth and offering a sign of love and respect.
